035924: function simLog(entry) {
035925:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035926:   const time = new Date();
035927:   const sequence = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(atlasFiniteNumber(state.sim.nextLogSequence, state.sim.logs.length + 1)));
035928:   state.sim.nextLogSequence = sequence + 1;

035930:   state.sim.logs = state.sim.logs.slice(0, 100);

035932: 
035933: function getPositionValue(symbol, scenarioPct = 0) {
035934:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035935:   const pos = state.sim.positions[symbol];
035936:   if (!pos) return 0;
035937:   return pos.qty * getPositionMarketPrice(symbol, scenarioPct);
035938: }
035939: 
035940: function estimatePositionExit(symbol, scenarioPct = 0, costs = readSimCostInputs()) {
035941:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035942:   const pos = state.sim.positions[symbol];
035943:   if (!pos) return null;
035944:   const marketPrice = getPositionMarketPrice(symbol, scenarioPct);
035945:   const exitExecutionPrice = marketPrice * (1 - costs.exitImpactPct / 100);
035946:   const grossExecutionValue = Math.max(0, pos.qty * exitExecutionPrice);
035947:   const sellFeeEur = grossExecutionValue * costs.sellFeePct / 100;
035948:   const netProceedsEur = Math.max(0, grossExecutionValue - sellFeeEur);
035949:   const grossMarketValue = pos.qty * marketPrice;
035950:   const grossPnlEur = grossMarketValue - pos.invested;
035951:   const netPnlEur = netProceedsEur - pos.invested;
035952:   const exitFactor = Math.max(0.000001, (1 - costs.exitImpactPct / 100) * (1 - costs.sellFeePct / 100));
035953:   const breakEvenMarketPrice = pos.qty > 0 ? pos.invested / (pos.qty * exitFactor) : 0;
035954:   return { marketPrice, exitExecutionPrice, grossMarketValue, grossExecutionValue, sellFeeEur, netProceedsEur, grossPnlEur, netPnlEur, breakEvenMarketPrice };
035955: }
035956: 
035957: function getSimulationTotals(scenarioPct = 0) {
035958:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035959:   const positionsValue = Object.keys(state.sim.positions).reduce((sum, sym) => sum + getPositionValue(sym, scenarioPct), 0);
035960:   const total = state.sim.cash + positionsValue;
035961:   return { positionsValue, total, pnl: total - state.sim.initialCash };
035962: }
035963: 
035964: function getSimulationNetTotals(scenarioPct = 0, costs = readSimCostInputs()) {
035965:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035966:   const exits = Object.keys(state.sim.positions).map(sym => estimatePositionExit(sym, scenarioPct, costs)).filter(Boolean);
035967:   const netPositionsValue = exits.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.netProceedsEur, 0);
035968:   const total = state.sim.cash + netPositionsValue;
035969:   return { netPositionsValue, total, pnl: total - state.sim.initialCash, exits };
035970: }
035971: 
035972: function getSimulationProfileStatus() {
035973:   if (!state.sim) loadSimulation();
035974:   const totals = getSimulationTotals();
035975:   const remainingExposure = Math.max(0, SIM_PROFILE.maxExposure - totals.positionsValue);
035976:   return { workspace: paperWorkspaceMeta404142(), profile: SIM_PROFILE.label, start_cash_eur: SIM_PROFILE.startCash, allowed_symbols: SIM_PROFILE.allowedSymbols, default_amount_eur: SIM_PROFILE.defaultAmount, max_per_operation_eur: SIM_PROFILE.maxPerOperation, max_exposure_eur: SIM_PROFILE.maxExposure, current_exposure_eur: totals.positionsValue, remaining_exposure_eur: remainingExposure, min_reserve_eur: SIM_PROFILE.minReserve, cash_eur: state.sim.cash };

035630: async function krakenCliAdapterFetch404144(path){
035631:   const ctl = new AbortController();
035632:   const timer = setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(), KRAKEN_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS_404144);
035633:   try{
035634:     const response = await fetch(`${KRAKEN_CLI_ADAPTER_BASE_404144}${path}`, { method:"GET", mode:"cors", cache:"no-store", signal:ctl.signal });
035635:     const text = await response.text();
035636:     let payload=null;
035637:     try{ payload=text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; }catch(_){ payload={ raw:text }; }
035638:     if(!response.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error(payload?.error || `HTTP ${response.status}`), { payload, status:response.status });
035639:     return payload;
035640:   } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
035641: }

035080: /* ============================================================
035081:    40.3.104 — EXTENDED MARKET -> NATIVE FICHE CRYPTO BRIDGE

035083:    40.3.102 correctly kept ARK/out-of-Top250 outside state.coins.

035109:     && atlasMarketExternal403100.status === "ready"
035110:   ) {
035111:     return external;

001336: function renderHumanCommand(result) { if (!els.commandHuman) return; const summary = humanCommandSummary(result); els.commandHuman.classList.toggle("ok", result?.ok !== false); els.commandHuman.classList.toggle("err", result?.ok === false); const bullets = summary.bullets.map(item => `<li>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>`).join(""); const tags = summary.tags.map(tag => `<span>${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join(""); els.commandHuman.innerHTML = ` <b>${escapeHtml(summary.title)}</b> <p>${escapeHtml(summary.text)}</p> <ul>${bullets}</ul> <div class="cmd-tags">${tags}</div> `;
001337: }
